entities.software: Names of software, tools, applications or services used for computer tasks; retain unfamiliar names
entities.computer_task: A task performed with a computer, including work, study and entertainment
entities.hardware_quantity: An explicit hardware component quantity including its number and unit
entities.performance_goal: A stated desired or acceptable experience, throughput, latency or task duration
entities.money_constraint: Budget or price with amount and direction, including its included or excluded scope

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Software, task, hardware or object that this single statement is about

fields.name: statement
fields.description: The complete original statement about this subject, retaining negation, time and conditions

fields.name: holder
fields.description: The person or computer whose requirement is being stated; retain another person's or a quoted subject

fields.name: execution_location
fields.description: Original words locating the task on this computer, a remote server, a cloud service or a shared computer

fields.name: time_expression
fields.description: Original words indicating when this task or need applied or will apply

fields.name: trigger
fields.description: An actual prerequisite or if/unless condition for this particular statement; not ordinary frequency or concurrent tasks

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Original quantitative target or observation including direction, number and unit; do not infer hardware needs

fields.name: frequency_or_concurrency
fields.description: Original statement of task frequency, workload size or simultaneously running tasks

fields.name: owner_scope
fields.description: Whose requirement this is, not who is merely mentioned
choices: quoted or test text, not a personal requirement

fields.name: source_relation
fields.description: Whether this statement affirms, negates, conditions or leaves uncertain the subject and value

fields.name: timeframe
fields.description: Time of this particular statement, not a document-wide label
